name: The Core Vault
lesson: The finale: scope what was stolen, defuse the ransomware before it triggers, rebuild the whole kill chain, contain in the right order, and capture the flag.
pivot_tip: Pivot on bytes_out. Beacons send hundreds of bytes; theft sends hundreds of megabytes.
reaction: vlk.exe's trigger time just moved up. VELVET LOCUST knows it's cornered.

e801.title: DLP alert: large transfer from VAULT-DB-01
lines: ALERT    : Abnormal outbound volume from a restricted-data server   Severity: CRITICAL
Volume   : 3 transfers, 1.21 GB total, 10:52-10:58 (before the C2 block at 11:04)
e801.tip: Exfiltration over the existing C2 channel: no new destination to spot, only a jump in volume. Scoping what left drives legal notification.

e802.title: BACKUP-01: ASR block + staged payload
lines: ASR BLOCKED : vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet   (parent: vlk.exe)
Note found  : README_VELVET.txt (draft) - 'your ledger is ours... pay or we publish'
e802.tip: Deleting shadow copies and staging an encryptor next to the backups is the last step before ransomware. You still have time.

e803.title: VAULT-DB-01 memory: implant state
lines: seal_key     : 0x5c   (used to sign the integrity seal over the vault)
e803.tip: svc_backup is still active and is a Backup Operator: it can read anything. Rotate it, and assume the domain itself may be at risk.

e804.title: Vault integrity seal
lines: Encoding: XOR (key from the implant's memory)
Decode the seal, then submit it in the terminal to lock the vault.
e804.tip: decode xor e804 <key>, then submit what it says.

objectives.title: Read the DLP alert
objectives.desc: Investigate VAULT-DB-01. The clock is running.
hints: The Vault node.
Press E at VAULT-DB-01.
Open 'DLP alert: large transfer from VAULT-DB-01'.

objectives.title: Scope the theft
objectives.desc: Find every connection that sent more than 100 MB (bytes_out > 100000000).
objectives.success: 1.21 GB went out over the C2 channel before you cut it. That's what Legal needs to know.
hints: Numeric comparisons work with > and <.
100 MB is 100000000 bytes.
search net where bytes_out>100000000

objectives.title: How was it packed?
objectives.desc: Find the archiving command on VAULT-DB-01.
objectives.solution: search proc where host="VAULT-DB-01" and parent="svchelper.exe"
objectives.success: 7-Zip, password-protected, split into 5 MB volumes. Archive via utility.
hints: What did the implant launch on the vault?
Filter on host and on the implant as the parent.
search proc where host="VAULT-DB-01" and parent="svchelper.exe"

objectives.title: What's armed on BACKUP-01?
objectives.desc: Find what ran on BACKUP-01 as svc_backup, apart from the backup software itself (hbackup.exe).
objectives.solution: search proc where host="BACKUP-01" and user="svc_backup" and name!="hbackup.exe"
objectives.success: vlk.exe tried to delete shadow copies (blocked) and passed its precheck. It's armed.
hints: The backup service account is svc_backup; hbackup.exe is its normal job.
Filter on host and user, and exclude the known-good name with !=.
search proc where host="BACKUP-01" and user="svc_backup" and name!="hbackup.exe"

objectives.title: Gather the endgame
objectives.desc: Collect the BACKUP-01 alert, the vault's memory analysis, and the integrity seal.
hints: BACKUP-01, FORENSICS-LAB, CORE-SEAL.
Press E at each.
Open all three records.

objectives.title: Rebuild the full kill chain
objectives.desc: Press L. Put the whole intrusion in order, from first email to last move.

events.label: Macro runs encoded PowerShell, downloads updchk.exe
Scheduled task + Run key keep updchk.exe alive
Discovery: admin groups enumerated, servers swept
Lateral movement: ADMIN$ + service, RDP to the vault
svchelper beacons over HTTPS and DNS
Ledger archived and exfiltrated; ransomware staged on BACKUP-01

objectives.success: Delivery to impact, end to end. That's the story you'll tell the board.
hints: You lived this in zone order.
Each zone you cleared is one step.
Zones 1 through 8, in order.

objectives.title: Final hypothesis
objectives.desc: Press B. Pin the proof and choose.

options.text: Espionage only: steal the ledger quietly and leave
options.feedback: Then why stage an encryptor and a ransom note next to the backups?

options.text: Double extortion: steal the ledger over C2, then encrypt backups and shares at 13:00 and threaten to publish
Pure ransomware with no data theft
options.feedback: 1.21 GB of the ledger already left. That's the 'double' in double extortion.

options.text: An insider copying files to a USB drive
options.feedback: The data went over the network to the C2 server, sent by the implant.

objectives.success: Confirmed: exfiltration plus impending encryption. Double extortion.
hints: Pin the DLP alert and the BACKUP-01 alert.
Was data stolen? Is encryption coming?
Pin e801 and e802, then choose double extortion.

objectives.title: Map the endgame
objectives.desc: Press M and map all three findings.
hints: Packing, sending, and the threatened impact.
Collection, Exfiltration, Impact.
f1 -> T1560.001 Archive via Utility; f2 -> T1041 Exfiltration Over C2 Channel; f3 -> T1486 Data Encrypted for Impact.

objectives.title: Full containment, in order
objectives.desc: Press R. Preserve, contain, eradicate, recover. Order matters.
hints: Preserve first. Contain before you eradicate. Recover last.
Snapshot, isolate, disarm vlk, rotate svc_backup and krbtgt, sweep IOCs, restore.
Follow the 'requires' chain: each step unlocks the next.

objectives.title: Break the seal
objectives.desc: Decode the vault's integrity seal with the key from the implant's memory: decode xor e804 0x5c
objectives.success: The seal reads true. Now submit it.
hints: The key is in the memory analysis (e803).
seal_key = 0x5c.
decode xor e804 0x5c

objectives.title: Capture the flag
hints: Type submit followed by the decoded seal.
It starts with HALCYON{.
submit HALCYON{contain_smart_hunt_smarter}

f1.text: 7za.exe packed D:\Ledger into a password-protected, split archive
f1.hint: They bundled the data before taking it.

f2.text: 1.21 GB of ledger_q3.7z sent to 203.0.113.66 over the existing C2 channel
f2.hint: The data left through the same channel as the commands.
f2.success: T1041 lit: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel.

f3.text: vlk.exe staged to encrypt backups and shares at 13:00 (shadow copy deletion blocked)
f3.hint: The threatened end goal: make the data unusable.
f3.success: Impact mapped. Threatened, and stopped in time.

responses.label: Snapshot VAULT-DB-01 and BACKUP-01 (memory + disk)
responses.description: Preserve the final state for forensics and legal.
responses.tradeoff: Minutes. Required for the notification report.

responses.label: Isolate VAULT-DB-01 and BACKUP-01 (CFO approved)
responses.tradeoff: Ledger offline for the recovery window.
responses.too_early: Snapshot first. You need proof of what was taken.
responses.feedback: Both contained. No more data leaves.

responses.label: Disarm \Halcyon\BackupVerify and quarantine vlk.exe
responses.description: Delete the 13:00 task and quarantine the encryptor.
responses.too_early: Contain BACKUP-01 first, or they'll trigger it early when they see you.
responses.feedback: Trigger removed, vlk.exe quarantined. The ransomware is defused.

responses.label: Disable svc_backup, rotate all service accounts, reset krbtgt twice
responses.description: Kill every credential they could still hold, including forged Kerberos tickets.
responses.tradeoff: Planned outage for services during rotation.
responses.too_early: Contain first; rotating while they're live on the box lets them grab the new secrets.
responses.feedback: Credentials rotated. Any tickets they forged are worthless.

responses.label: Eradicate fleet-wide: sweep and remove every IOC
responses.description: Hunt all hosts for updchk, odsync, svchelper, vlk, the tasks, Run keys, and services.
responses.too_early: Contain and rotate credentials first, or they reinfect what you clean.
responses.feedback: Sweep complete: 4 hosts cleaned, 0 IOCs remaining.

responses.label: Recover: restore from verified offline backups and monitor 30 days
responses.description: Rebuild from known-good, then watch closely.
responses.tradeoff: The ledger is back in four hours.
responses.too_early: Restoring before eradication just restores into an infected network.
responses.feedback: Restored from offline backups. Enhanced monitoring on.

responses.label: Pay the ransom so the ledger isn't published
responses.tradeoff: No guarantee; funds crime; may be illegal.
responses.feedback: Paying guarantees nothing and funds the next attack. Escalate to legal and leadership; contain and recover instead.

responses.label: Email all staff about the breach from corporate mail
responses.tradeoff: The adversary may still read mailboxes.
responses.feedback: Use out-of-band channels during an active incident. The adversary may be reading corporate mail.

puzzle.title: CTF Cache: Core Vault
puzzle.clue: One last cache. decode base64 cache
